title: November Raku Firing
source_quote: November Raku Firing Nov 22, 2026 Firing Only great for: Everyone Nov 22, 2026
evidence_sentence: November raku firing on Nov 22, 2026 lets potters bring bisqued pieces and fire 3–5 pieces using onsite glazes with hot-pull reduction.
evidence_quote: Come join us for an awesome day of Raku at our Atmospheric Firing Center!
summary: Raku firing Nov 22, 2026 (8am–3pm); bring bisqued pieces (3–5, max 1000 cu in). $120 includes access to 12 onsite raku glazes. Hot pulls and reduction included. Sold out.
bring: Bisqued pieces, 3–5 pieces not exceeding 1000 cubic inches total
